_comment: Two objects per grid; the LARGER object is recoloured in place to match the SMALLER object's colour (smaller unchanged, grid unchanged). The mirror of recolor_to_largest.json: selector=largest, source=smallest. Authored so the recolour family's (selector, source) DIVERGE across two tasks, forcing save_rule -> anti_unification.unify() to lift both to ?v and produce ONE covers=2 rule with a trace (R3), proving the selectors are fitted not hardcoded. Value-agnostic: colours/sizes differ across pairs.
